question.purpose: Quiz question text, distinct from Headline.

label.purpose: Metadata and category tags, tracked uppercase.

statsNum.purpose: Any gamified counter — XP, streak, accuracy.

shadows.name: shadow-gamified
shadows.purpose: The only sanctioned shadow — soft, blue-tinted, ambient. Completed/checkpoint map nodes, in-progress unit card only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action; solid primary fill. Carries an unsanctioned shadow-sm — flagged in DESIGN.md for removal.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #0e4471; color: #ffffff; border: 2px solid #0e4471; border-radius: 24px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2e5c8a; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Gamification CTA Button
components.description: Reward-flavored CTA; border collapses on press for a physical 'pushed' feel.
components.css: .ds-btn-gamification { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #fda864; color: #753c00; border: none; border-bottom: 4px solid #8f4e0f; border-radius: 24px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; transition: transform 0.1s, border-bottom-width 0.1s; } .ds-btn-gamification:active { transform: translateY(4px); border-bottom-width: 0; }

components.name: Answer Card — Selected
components.description: Quiz answer option, selected/unverified state, with themed focus ring.
components.css: .ds-answer-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #121c2a; text-align: left; } .ds-answer-selected { border: 2px solid #0e4471; background: #d1e4ff; } .ds-answer-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e4471; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Answer Card — Correct
components.description: Quiz answer option revealed as correct.
components.css: .ds-answer-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-answer-correct { border: 2px solid #004e10; background: #a3f69c; color: #005312; }

narrative.overview: Same system as apps/mobile — this is the browser expression of the shared Blueprint Narrative tokens, ported to Tailwind v4 via @theme rather than reimplemented. The hybrid of Modern Minimalism and Technical Brutalism shows up literally on <body> here: a real 24x24px blueprint-grid background image, always on, everywhere — the single most on-theme decision in either codebase. Web carries a Teacher Panel and admin surface mobile explicitly doesn't; the Teacher Dashboard deliberately shifts to a Density-First mode with tighter padding.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp, structured geometry — never bubbly or soft-gamified
The literal blueprint grid lives on <body> here — mobile only approximates it in LoadingBlueprint's fullscreen variant
One color per job: blue = learning/navigation, orange = gamification, green = success — never mixed
prefers-reduced-motion is handled globally, genuinely accessibility-aware, ahead of apps/mobile on this axis

rules.name: The One Job Per Color Rule
rules.body: Blue is structural/navigational, orange is exclusively gamification reward, green is exclusively success/validation.

rules.name: The Mono-Counts Rule
rules.body: Anything the user watches go up (XP, streak, accuracy) renders in text-stats-num + font-label (JetBrains Mono), never the body or display font.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; the only earned depth is shadow-gamified on completed/checkpoint map nodes and the in-progress unit card — never a generic Tailwind shadow utility.

dos: Do use shadow-gamified only for the small named set of critical gamified elements it was built for.
Do keep the Teacher Dashboard's denser sm padding as a deliberate mode switch.
Do pair every color-coded correct/incorrect state with a dedicated icon.
donts: Don't reach for Tailwind's bare shadow-sm/md/lg anywhere — Button.tsx's primary variant currently does; flagged for removal.
Don't silently reconcile the 12px-vs-16px answer-card radius gap between mobile and web by copying one value over the other without a deliberate decision.
